source.name: Louisiana Dept. of Conservation and Energy (SONRIS), Oil/Gas Wells map service

at_risk.definition: SONRIS status Shut-in (future utility) or PA-35 temporary inactive, with an operator named.

verification_note: Not cross-checked for operator. All 4,729 USGS Louisiana wells with an API number match SONRIS, and SONRIS flags 4,470 of them as orphaned (ORPHANED_FLAG = Y). The other 249 USGS rows have no API number.
notes: USGS status 'ACT 404 ORPHAN WELL' refers to Louisiana's orphan well statute (Act 404).
